description: Update an existing Incident State Timeline in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_incident_state_timeline afterwards to see the updated record.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Incident State Timeline to update. Required. Use list_incident_state_timelines to find IDs.

incidentStateId.description: Incident State ID Relation. Which incident state does this incident change to?

startsAt.description: When did this status change? Correct this when the recorded time is wrong - every measurement derived from this timeline is recomputed from the corrected value.

name: update_incident_state_timeline
title: Update Incident State Timeline
